# Jan-Marlon Leibl

> Jan-Marlon Leibl is a software developer from Bremen, Germany, and the founder of Finny. He works mainly with PHP, TypeScript, React and Next.js. This file indexes the public, machine-readable resources on the current site.

## Profile resources

- [English profile](https://itsjan.dev/en.md): Full English profile with experience, projects, technologies and contact links.
- [German profile](https://itsjan.dev/de.md): Full German-language profile with experience, projects, technologies and contact links.
- [Full context](https://itsjan.dev/llms-full.txt): Expanded English context intended for assistants and agents.
- [Public profile skill](https://itsjan.dev/skills/itsjan-profile/SKILL.md): Installable agent context with verified public facts and source guidance.

## Current work

- [Finny](https://fnny.app): An app that keeps receipts, purchase details and warranty dates in one place, then reminds the user before a warranty expires.
- [Ventry](https://ventry.host): A file-sharing project built around expiring links that remove the shared file automatically.
- [Portfolio source](https://github.com/AtomicWasTaken/itsjan-personal-page): Source code for itsjan.dev, built with Astro and deployed on Cloudflare Workers.
